Minimal cloud cover and absent rainfall in current model guidance further support sustained heating, though any earlier-than-expected coastal breeze or localized convection could cap readings near 36°C. Updated PMD advisories and next-model runs over the next 48 hours remain the key variables for resolution.

title: Highest temperature in Manila on May 26?
description:

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day by the Forecast for the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station once information is finalized, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/ph/manila/RPLL.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent forecasts from meteorological agencies indicate Manila's May 26 high will likely reach 35–37°C amid the peak of the pre-monsoon hot season in this tropical climate. Historical May averages hover near 34°C, with recent days recording 34–36°C and heat indices exceeding 40°C due to humidity. Model consensus points to limited cloud cover and weak steering winds allowing daytime heating to peak in this range, though afternoon thunderstorms could slightly suppress maxima. These conditions position the 36°C and 37°C outcomes as market leaders, reflecting trader assessment of current observational trends and short-range forecast stability ahead of the May 26 resolution window.
